{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/penguins.csv')

# Confirm number of non-missing body_mass_g values
n_non_missing = df['body_mass_g'].notnull().sum()
print("Number of penguins with non-missing body_mass_g:", n_non_missing)

# Compute mean body mass, dropping missing values
mean_body_mass = df['body_mass_g'].mean()
print("Mean body mass (grams):", mean_body_mass)"}
